generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `MapperService.parseMapping` public methods have their signatures changed (a `MergeReason` parameter is inserted) without preserving the old two-argument overloads. In contrast, `MappingParser` (package-private) does keep the old `parse(type, source)` overload. Since `MapperService` is a public API consumed by plugins and other modules, removing the old signatures is a breaking change. If backward compatibility for plugin developers matters, consider keeping the old two-arg overloads that delegate with `MergeReason.MAPPING_UPDATE`, mirroring what was done in `MappingParser` and `MapperBuilderContext.root()`.

review_comment: To be safe, could you also add a test for the invers? Have the nested notation first (mapping2) and then the dot notation (mapping1). In theory, should not make a difference but I rather have one test to much then too little.
Sure! I added that scenario with [cb28cdb](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/106077/commits/cb28cdbe5a47b0d3b527087acc192abfa387d266).
